name: Open Workbook
description: Open an existing .xlsx — a template the finance team styled in Excel and shipped as a resource, an upload, a stored file — from base64 or from what a Read File step answered. Every style, merge, width and formula in it is kept; fill it with Fill Placeholders, Fill Table or Set Cell.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= workbook.xlsx.load(Uint8Array.from(atob(typeof source === 'object' && source && source.base64 ? source.base64 : String(source ?? '').replace(/^data:[^,]*,/, '').replace(/\\s+/g, '')), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0))).then(() => workbook) }}"}]
